text:
maria_ml: Quick heads-up - q4b-int8 canary is failing on long-context prompts (>2048 tokens). Symptoms: truncation, repeated segments, incoherent continuations. Detected in legal summarization and transcript tests.

jonathan: numbers? where's the dashboard?

maria_ml: ROUGE-L down ~6.4 vs q8 baseline; QA EM down ~9.2%; human pass rate drop ~12% on longform golden. Short prompts are fine. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/perf/q4b-canary (internal)

deploy-bot: Canary deployment 1709876543 -> q4b-int8-canary started 2025-09-02T15:12Z. 12% traffic.

kevin_labeling: Our long-context golden is small (~350 examples) and biased to shorter long prompts. We need to expand to include html blobs, multi-speaker transcripts, long code files.

samuel_quant: Hypothesis: int8 kernel path improperly handles KV-cache dynamics across long sequences. I'll test packed-kv layout + layernorm-fp16 workaround.

maria_ml: run targeted eval (500 long prompts) with packed-kv + layernorm-fp16, keep params identical to baseline.

samuel_quant: config I'll test:
```
quant: int8
kv_layout: packed
layernorm: fp16-stable
chunk_attn: true
```
Job qtest-4578 started, ETA ~2h.

lena: I'll assemble 1k long-context golden (legal excerpts, meeting transcripts, long FAQs, html dumps). Plan: seed from longprompt-bank v3, dedupe with fuzzyhash-v2, stratify by length/speaker. ETA 48h.

kevin_labeling: I'll prep annotation rubric: pass/fail + error-type tags [truncation, repetition, hallucination, incoherent]. Can allocate 4 labelers to priority batch.

anya_prod: If regression >10% on longform SLAs, prepare rollback plan. Ops: what's SLA exposure at 12% traffic? moderate; customers flagged issues yesterday.

maria_ml: action items: lena assemble 1k golden (48h); kevin prepare schema + labelers (24h); samuel run micro-eval (2h); anya prepare rollback (ASAP).

samuel_quant: micro-eval done: packed-kv reduces ROUGE-L gap to 1.8 points (was 6.4). Repetition errors down 60%. Results uploaded: https://redwood.internal/ci/qtest-4578/results

maria_ml: promising. scheduling 30m sync to decide patch vs rollback. jonathan: can we patch canary config and re-run full canary against expanded golden before rollback?

jonathan: yes. will join.

lena: dedupe first pass: 1.4k seeds -> 1,020 after fuzzyhash-v2. Posting collision report and stratification shortly.

kevin_labeling: prepping annotation sheet and QC checks. Prefer simple binary + tag UI.

maria_ml: thanks; keep updates here for provenance. Meeting in 30m.
